name: Game CPU boost
purpose: while a game window is the one the user plays (GameBoost.kt: its window task in front, or its web window full screen / last pressed, screen on), one sh holder as Android root (the app's root shell starts it: files/game-boost.sh engage) lifts the big clusters' scaling_max_freq to hw max and scaling_min_freq to ~80 %, puts the game's threads in /dev/cpuctl/powos-game (cpu.uclamp.min 75), its hottest thread on the prime core and the rest on the other big cores; all saved first and put back when the game leaves the front, closes, the screen turns off, or the app's lease is 4 s old (the app died). Thermal limits and cooling devices are never touched
installedBy: the PowOS APK (targets/android/app: shell/GameBoost.kt, assets/game-boost.sh copied to the app's files)
unbounded: one sh loop, 1 s ticks, only while a game is in front; a /proc scan for the game's threads every 5 s; its log capped at 64 KB (+ one .1)
